text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Led by Daiichi Ruby and Daitaku Helios, 
the sprint division boasts a formidable 
lineup of runners.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Preparing for their eventual showdown, 
K.S. Miracle continues training late into 
the night.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And— it was time to face the Hakodate 
Sprint Stakes.
